# customer-ui

> The customer-facing single-page application for the order-commerce platform.
> It lets a customer apply one or more coupon codes and track an order's status
> through the lifecycle CREATED -> CONFIRMED -> DELIVERED. All coupon-validity
> and order-status verdicts are server-authoritative: the UI renders results
> from the order-service HTTP API and makes no such decisions of its own.

## Application

- The app is built with React 19 and Vite 6. It has no client-side router
  library; routing is implemented with the browser History API.
- Routes: `/` (apply coupons and create or open an order) and `/orders/:id`
  (order tracking with a CREATED -> CONFIRMED -> DELIVERED status stepper).

## Order-service API (proxied same-origin in dev/preview)

- `POST /coupons/validate` — validate a single coupon code; body `{ code }`.
- `POST /orders` — create an order; body `{ price, couponCodes }`; returns the
  created order (including its id and status).
- `GET /orders/{id}` — retrieve an order's current status.
- `POST /orders/{id}/status` — advance an order to its next lifecycle status.

## Notes

- This file and `robots.txt` are static metadata served from Vite's `public/`
  directory; metadata requests are answered with the real static file rather
  than the SPA's `index.html` fallback.
